entries.invariance_equivariance: Any native claim must be invariant under the full incidence automorphism group.

language_well_typed.group_or_configuration_valued_role: YES in principle using definable incidence automorphism/configuration objects, but there is no distinguished turn/direction object.

entries.role_object_exists: No scalar pi-role object is expressible in the native signature. Incidence invariants may exist but do not supply a typed scalar period.
entries.uniqueness: NOT_APPLICABLE for scalar role because typability already fails.

entries.invariance_equivariance: The half-cycle permutation is invariant under cyclic relabeling and also unchanged by reversing the chosen cyclic generator when the boundary length is even.

language_well_typed.permutation_or_cyclic_group_role: YES on a finite boundary component because its successor permutation is definable.
language_well_typed.scalar_valued_role: NO as a native geometric scalar; finite cardinal arithmetic is only a finite/readout layer.

entries.role_object_exists: A canonical half-cycle permutation exists precisely on finite even boundary cycles; it is absent on odd cycles.
entries.uniqueness: When the boundary length is even, it is the unique nonidentity involution in the cyclic subgroup generated by boundary successor.

entries.invariance_equivariance: A parameter-free scalar claim must survive allowed field automorphisms and affine semilinear equivalences.

language_well_typed.metric_or_angle_role: NO: no order, norm, congruence, direction orientation, or angular structure is present.
language_well_typed.scalar_valued_role: YES syntactically because K is a scalar sort.

entries.role_object_exists: Field constants and definable field elements may exist, but the affine-plane axioms alone supply no role predicate selecting a distinguished pi-like scalar.
entries.uniqueness: NOT_FORCED: mere availability of K does not specify a distinguished scalar satisfying a pi-role predicate.

entries.invariance_equivariance: Each construction is invariant under full S3 isomorphisms because q and the unique group involution are signature data/definable.

language_well_typed.scalar_angle_role: NO: no scalar angular codomain is declared.

entries.role_object_exists: Both the two-sheet deck involution delta_q and rho(z), the action of the unique group involution, exist.
entries.uniqueness: Each role is individually unique, but their equality is NOT forced.

entries.invariance_equivariance: They are invariant under order-preserving affine semilinear equivalences.

language_well_typed.scalar_angle_role: NO as such: K is present but no map from direction transformations to K is declared.

entries.role_object_exists: The positive-ray/unoriented-direction two-cover and scalar-negation involution are definable from the ordered affine substrate.
entries.uniqueness: The deck involution and negation action are each unique and coincide by the ordered-ray construction.

entries.invariance_equivariance: It is invariant under exact S5 automorphisms preserving N and mu.

language_well_typed.angular_scalar_role: Still not typed unless an additional angular readout is declared.
language_well_typed.raw_isoperimetric_role: YES in the declared order-completion Cut(K).

entries.role_object_exists: The raw polygonal isoperimetric infimum exists as an order-completion cut because the admissible ratio set is nonempty and bounded below by zero.
entries.uniqueness: Unique within a fixed S5 model/cut completion, but not determined by the coarser S4+N reduct because mu may be rescaled.

entries.invariance_equivariance: The unordered inversion class of generators is invariant; a raw generator is not invariant under kernel inversion.

language_well_typed.raw_kernel_generator: YES as a predicate on TurnLift, but not uniquely selectable.
language_well_typed.scalar_period: NO: no angular scalar map/unit is declared.

entries.role_object_exists: ker(p) is infinite cyclic, so generators exist; exactly two raw generators occur and are inverse to one another.
entries.uniqueness: Raw generator: NO. Inversion-quotient generator class: YES.
